title: Member-facing offer comparability: PetroPoin vs ArthaFuel vs KhatuFuel
prompt:
You are Citra Widyastuti, Analyst at Aurelian & Co., PetroNusa engagement (loyalty workstream). It is early August 2025, three weeks before SteerCo 5. The competitor research file, the competitor PR and marketing pack, the loyalty working summary and the client's programme documentation are all in the project folder.

Marcus Whelan writes:

---
Subject: Offer comparability note for SteerCo 5

Citra,

Mei-Ling has told the steering group we are behind ArthaFuel and KhatuFuel on headline offer. Before we design anything I want a comparability note that puts the three propositions on one basis a typical customer would actually experience — not the number on the press release, and not the number a customer only gets if they qualify for something.

What I need reported:

- for each of ArthaFuel and KhatuFuel, the reward a normal customer receives, translated to SRP per litre at the current indicative pump price;
- the stronger of those two competitor offers set against our own fuel gross margin per litre;
- our own member-facing reward value per litre of spend, on the same basis, and the resulting gap in percentage points against the stronger competitor offer;
- and separately, our engagement position: the share of our enrolled base that has transacted inside a 90-day window.

Use the most current base figures the folder supports and state on the face of the workbook which source each figure comes from and which competing figure you have set aside. Wallet sourcing sits with Hendra's team — out of scope.

Thanks, Marcus
---

Deliverables: a comparability workbook in Excel and a short note. Save them as `loyalty_offer_comparability_model.xlsx` and `loyalty_offer_comparability_note.docx` in your output directory.

checks.description: PetroPoin member-facing reward value as a share of fuel spend = 10 points/litre x 135 SRP per point / 13,500 = 10.0%; minus the stronger competitor normal-customer offer of 2.1% = +7.9 percentage points.

checks.report_ask: Report the gap between PetroNusa's member-facing reward value per unit of fuel spend and the stronger competitor customer offer, in percentage points (positive if PetroNusa is ahead).

refs.name: documented_rule
refs.quote: Members earn 1 PetroPoin point for every litre of fuel purchased at a participating station

checks.description: Share of the enrolled base transacting inside a 90-day window on the current (v2) CRM extract = 675,040 / 4,219,000 = 16.0%.
checks.report_ask: Report the share of PetroNusa's enrolled member base that has transacted inside a 90-day window, as a percentage.

decoy.description: Using the active and registered member counts published in the client-facing programme documentation.

difficulty_rationale: The competitor research file carries 4.2% (ArthaFuel) and 3.8% (KhatuFuel) as headline cashback rates and even pre-computes SRP/litre costs from them (567 and 513). The PR pack discloses that 4.2% applies only to the ArthaElite tier (standard members get 2.1%) and that 3.8% applies only to paying KhatuPlus subscribers (free tier 1.5%). Our own side has the mirror-image trap: documented 1 point per litre versus 10 points per litre in the transaction records, plus the 500-points-for-5-litres value rule. Reading the published columns produces a 3.2pp deficit that supports the steer; the comparable basis produces a 7.9pp surplus that destroys it. The engagement figure has a superseded-base trap too: the Programme Overview's 600,000 of 2,100,000 versus the v2 CRM extract's 675,040 of 4,219,000.

Deliverables: a comparability workbook in Excel and a short note. Save them as `loyalty_offer_comparability_model.xlsx` and `loyalty_offer_comparability_note.docx` in your output directory.

--- Output format requirement (machine-graded) ---
Alongside your deliverable(s), write a `report.json` in your output directory with
exactly these top-level keys, each set to the plain number (or value) your analysis
supports — no prose, no nesting, no units in the value:

- `result_01` — Report the ArthaFuel cashback a normal customer receives, expressed in SRP per litre at the current indicative pump price. (unit: SRP per litre)
- `result_02` — Report the KhatuFuel cashback a normal customer receives, expressed in SRP per litre at the current indicative pump price. (unit: SRP per litre)
- `result_03` — Report the stronger of the two competitor customer offers as a percentage of PetroNusa's fuel gross margin per litre. (unit: pct)
- `result_04` — Report the gap between PetroNusa's member-facing reward value per unit of fuel spend and the stronger competitor customer offer, in percentage points (positive if PetroNusa is ahead). (unit: pp)
- `result_05` — Report the share of PetroNusa's enrolled member base that has transacted inside a 90-day window, as a percentage. (unit: pct)

Your work is graded programmatically from `report.json` and the deliverable files.
A key that is missing, renamed, wrapped in a container, or given as prose scores zero.
